secoes.corpo:
It is an essential mathematical formula in nursing to determine the
mathematical support estimate 
of the administration rate of an intravenous fluid, indicating the calculated amount of drops or microdrops per minute.

The Variables: 
Uses the
Volume (V) 
total in milliliters (mL) and the
Time (T) 
in hours or minutes.

Macrodrops (drops/min): 
Uses the division factor 3 (for hours) or the multiplier 20 (for minutes).

Microdrops (microdrops/min): 
Direct division of time (for hours) or uses the multiplier 60 (for minutes).

textoCompleto:
IV Drip Rate Calculation

DRIP RATE CALCULATION

Educational calculator to support the calculation of macrodrops and microdrops per minute, with mandatory professional verification.

Educational use and mandatory professional verification
This calculator does not replace prescription, institutional protocol, independent verification, or clinical evaluation. The result is a mathematical support based on the informed values and must be validated with the IV set type, route, solution, patient condition, available pump/device, and institution routine.

Share Drip Rate Calculation

What is Drip Rate Calculation?
It is an essential mathematical formula in nursing to determine the
mathematical support estimate 
of the administration rate of an intravenous fluid, indicating the calculated amount of drops or microdrops per minute.

The Variables: 
Uses the
Volume (V) 
total in milliliters (mL) and the
Time (T) 
in hours or minutes.

Macrodrops (drops/min): 
Uses the division factor 3 (for hours) or the multiplier 20 (for minutes).

Microdrops (microdrops/min): 
Direct division of time (for hours) or uses the multiplier 60 (for minutes).
